questieToc.scope: Exact typed startedBy/finishedBy/sourceItemId and reciprocal item startQuest facts. Recorded evidence only, not current availability or coordinate proof.

priorCatalog.scope: Exact previously shipped associations, labels, faction scopes and positions retained without loss; source facts are not reattributed to the newer role proof.

limitations: Generic provider relationships do not establish starter role. Withheld item associations remain recorded with unknown role unless an explicit supplied-item field exists. Positive finisher proof separates turn-in locations from starters. Historical source rows and coordinates do not prove current realm availability; no replacement starter, NPC name, restriction or coordinate is inferred.

records.reason: Retain the exact prior association and coordinates under its recorded role. A supplied item or finisher is not a starter; an unsupported generic item provider retains unknown role without claiming its absence from the current realm.
